before: The private adapter had no application-owned boundary for Yjs attributes inherited by unseen concurrent text.
after: An optional private collaboration entry records observed character intervals and insertion baselines, scopes native attributes before observers, and publishes restored-character lineage. The evaluation harness can enable this protocol before room bootstrap.
reason: Published native codecs, format versions, journals, and transport implementation remain unchanged. The private application protocol is explicitly version 1 and requires every room participant to attach the boundary. It does not interoperate with legacy application rooms. Hosts must gate the application protocol separately, and adopt it through stopped-writer DOCX export and fresh-room bootstrap. Full replacement placement remains R29 work. No published package source changes in this leaf.
